claims.assertion: Mari said earlier contactors overextended themselves by accommodating interviewers and sharing without boundaries, leading to exhaustion and conflicts over unmet expectations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She said service-to-others can become exploitative in Earth’s scarcity mindset and argued that extraterrestrials also have ordinary needs rather than owing humanity rescue.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari said she would publish independently in a focused, gradual format to avoid repeating prior contactors’ errors; she identified other humans in space as the project’s central implication.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
